Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 104, verse 1:

﴿Woe﴾ is a word of punishment, or a valley in Hell, ﴿to every backbiter and slanderer﴾, i.e., one who frequently engages in hamz (striking/defaming with the face or gesture) and lamz (slandering with the tongue), i.e., ghiba (backbiting). It was revealed concerning those who used to backbite the Prophet ﷺ and the believers, such as Ummayah ibn Khalaf, al-Walid ibn al-Mughirah, and others.

﴿Who has gathered wealth and counted it﴾ — with light and heavy pronunciation (jama'a / jammaa'a). ﴿Wealth﴾ — and counted it: he kept count of it (aḥṣāhu), and made it a store (ʿudda) against the vicissitudes of time.
﴿He thinks﴾ because of his ignorance ﴿that his wealth has made him eternal﴾, meaning it made him immortal, one who does not die.

Nay! (﴿كَلّا﴾) a rebuke. ﴿Surely he shall be thrown﴾ (﴿لَيُنَبَذَنَّ﴾) is the answer to an implied oath, meaning: he shall certainly be cast ﴿into the Crushing Fire﴾ (﴿فِي الحُطَمَة﴾), the one that crushes everything thrown into it.
﴿And what will make you know what the Crusher is?﴾ — it informs you (أعلمك, a‘lamaka), ﴿what the Crusher is﴾ (al-Ḥuṭamah).
﴿The fire of Allah, kindled,﴾ the blazing fire.

Surah 104 (al-Humaza), verse 7:

﴿Which mounts over the hearts﴾ [i.e., which rises up and overlooks] ﴿the hearts﴾ [i.e., the inner hearts], so that it burns them; and its pain is more intense than the pain of other [parts of the body], because of their delicacy [i.e., the tenderness of the hearts].

Commentary of al-Mahalli & al-Suyuti (Tafsir al-Jalalayn) on surah 104, verse 8:

﴿Indeed, it will be closed over them﴾ The pronoun is plural in respect of the meaning of "each" (kull). ﴿Mu'sadah﴾ (closed over), with a hamza, and with a waw instead of it (mu'sadah becoming mu'sadah/mu'wadah), meaning sealed shut (mutbaqah).

Qur'an 104:9 — "In columns (ʿamad) that are outstretched."

﴿In columns﴾ — read with both letters vowelled with a ḍamma and with a fatḥa (ʿamad and ʿumud, i.e. two readings) — ﴿outstretched﴾ is an adjective of what precedes it, so that the Fire is inside the columns.
